Title: Upload to Workshop Unlisted
Description:
Current version is v1.0.0

Adds a 4th option to the visibility dropdown in the Modding Toolkit Workshop Uploader for "Unlisted", addressing issue tracker [url=https://gitlab.com/freehold/cavesofqud-public-issue-tracker/-/work_items/14891]#14891[/url].

It definitely works. This mod was uploaded, unlisted, to the workshop with this mod enabled, and has since been made public.

See [url=https://github.com/UnderDoug/UD_Workshop_Upload_Unlisted]the source[/url] if you are so inclined.
